scientific_integrity: Two independently implemented complete finite compatibility-clique enumerations, explicit complete equality-case data, and direct symmetry checks are supplied. No claims of independent mathematical audit, universal historical novelty, or higher-blocklength results.
scientific_limitations: Finite length-two-through-six exhaustive result only; frame boundary is assumed known before substitution decoding; uncorrupted non-overlap is not a noisy synchronization theorem; inaccessible full text on partially overlap-free Hamming-distance-constrained constructions leaves a literature priority risk.
title: Sharp ternary short-block synchronization and single-substitution correction through length six
